text.tspan: Threshold income per month marking the poorest decile, the median,

and the richest decile (before tax)
1968 to 2024
The level of income per person per month below which 10%, 50% and 90% of the population falls. Income here is measured
before taxes and benefits. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

Note: This data is expressed in
international-$
at 2021 prices. Income has been
equivalized
.
